decision_reason: The semantic delta is bounded Rust control logic over RunId, SlotIdx, PendingTimerKind, Ask/AskResume node shape, and enqueue/no-enqueue result. Kani is required to cover valid and invalid answer_slot behavior without hardcoded shapes; planned harness must use kani::any()/Arbitrary-style bounded generators for workflow/timer/slot cases.
model_bounds: SlotIdx domain: u16 values including 0 and u16::MAX
bounded workflow nodes: Ask at pending step, optional next resume step, AskResume/non-AskResume variants
no live scheduler or IPC socket modeling

decision_reason: Randomized value coverage is required for postcard AnswerAsk roundtrip and answer_slot equality/mismatch behavior beyond deterministic examples. Existing vb_ipc and vb_runtime crates already have proptest dev-dependencies, so this is tooling-fit.
model_bounds: answer bytes bounded to <= 65536 for accepted handler paths
malformed SlotValue bytes included as error-path cases

decision_reason: AnswerAsk is an IPC binary hostile-input boundary decoded from arbitrary frame/payload bytes. Existing fuzz targets ipc_decode and ipc_frame_fuzz_boundary already exercise IpcPayload destructuring including AnswerAsk.run_id and answer_slot; the plan requires refreshing those targets so the new shape and taint field are covered by hostile bytes.
model_bounds: payload decode may reject arbitrary bytes but must never panic
accepted AnswerAsk payloads must expose run_id/answer_slot/answer/taint without legacy ticket assumption

decision_reason: Scoped source has no Flux annotations for Runtime, Shard, IpcPayload, SlotIdx, PendingTimer, or CompiledWorkflow; existing Flux artifact inventory under crates/vb_runtime/src/verification/flux contains only vb_y9d3v_action_ticket_refinements.rs for action ticket fences. The repaired delta is control-flow equality/variant checking over existing production types, better matched by Kani/proptest and behavior tests until Flux extern specs exist for these types.

No production-bound Verus annotations exist for Runtime::answer_pending_ask_slot, Shard pending timer access, CompiledWorkflow::node, or IpcPayload. A standalone mirror of Ask/AskResume equality would violate the repository no-vacuum-Verus rule because it would not bind to production exec functions. Kani/proptest are planned against production seams instead.

decision_reason: The scoped repair does not introduce atomics, locks, channels, spawned tasks, cancellation, or scheduler interleavings. IPC handler and Runtime::answer_pending_ask_slot are synchronous calls over &mut Runtime / &self plus shard queue enqueue. Crossbeam/rtrb internals are existing runtime infrastructure outside this semantic delta.

Relevant first-party files explicitly forbid unsafe code and the change is serde/postcard decoding plus safe Rust enum/slot equality. No raw pointers, FFI, custom allocators, MaybeUninit, provenance, or aliasing-sensitive unsafe path is in scope.
